summary: Anthropic announced a partnership with Tata Consultancy Services under which TCS will deploy Claude to 50,000 of its own employees, build Claude-powered products for regulated industries such as financial services and healthcare, and join the Claude Partner Network.

mechanisms.reason: A large-scale enterprise rollout across tens of thousands of employees and services touching tens of millions of end customers adds to aggregate Claude usage, though this is a single partner's deployment rather than an industry-wide shift.
mechanisms.quote: TCS will provide Claude to 50,000 of its own employees across 56 countries
